commands.summary: Backend build passed after adding the launch-only GET /api/device/operator-status transport with an injectable runner and the default execFile-based wrapper invocation.

Server tests passed, including the operator-status transport: injected runner returns/echoes request_id, unsafe request_id is replaced with a safe generated one before reaching the runner, the route is launch-only (MCP token gets 401), and an unconfigured bridge returns a degraded ok:false body.
37 renderer tests passed, including the panel's live 'Check device status' path fetching through the transport endpoint and rendering Online.
Full Electron validation passed: backend build, renderer build, renderer interactions, Node test bundle, and syntax checks.
RepoPact plus ForgeLink local validation passed for the work-item, docs, evidence, and CHANGELOG updates.

environment.process_note: TAURI-009: GET /api/device/operator-status is launch-only and not MCP-reachable. The script path comes only from FORGELINK_OPERATOR_STATUS_SCRIPT (optional FORGELINK_OPERATOR_STATUS_SHELL, default powershell); the only request input is a request_id validated against ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,80}$ and passed through an execFile arg array (no shell string). The subprocess is bounded by a 10s timeout and 1MB buffer. Any failure (unset env, non-zero exit, timeout, non-JSON) resolves to a degraded {ok:false} body that the renderer renders as Degraded. No raw ADB/Fastboot/shell surface is exposed. Disabled by default until the operator sets the script path.
